name: DF64 Gen 2
details: Single-dose flat-burr grinder, used for espresso.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 0–4, espresso 0–20, moka pot 19–49, AeroPress 15–80, V60 23–53, filter coffee machine 13–74, French press 53–90, cold brew 65–90. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
